originalYouTubeMetadata.title: Koopa Troopa Beach R 1:15.02 (37.11/37.91) | World Record | Mario Kart Tour
originalYouTubeMetadata.description:
Best splits 37.11/37.84, so sub 1:15 is possible. I had like 6 .11 lap 1s. This run was ok. Had many chances at a possible sub 1:15, but never was quite able to get over that barrier. Maybe if it comes back for a 3rd time (highly unlikely as that has never happened before in MKT), I will get the 1:14. I can already think of some slight alterations that could put me over the edge. I didn't really analyze video or test things out because I was too lazy; I kinda just drove and got the times that I got. 

Last year in May 2021 this track came around for the first time. I grinded my way to a 1:15.37 and held the current World Record at the time before eventually losing that World Record by 0.04 seconds. Having started time trialing competitively about 6 months prior in December 2020, I felt it was a pretty big accomplishment. Never thought I would ever achieve that. Ever since that near-World Record, I became hungry to finally get one. And I knew that when this track eventually came back, I would look to take that World Record. Well, I've gotten 3 World Records in the meantime, and have now taken the World Record here on this track upon its return, which I am pretty pleased about. Would have loved the 1:14 but oh well. Maybe in the future there will be more World Records for me to achieve, so long as I have the motivation to grind for them. I actually maintained my motivation for this track throughout the entire tour, which is something that has not happened for several months now; typically nowadays I just play a little bit to see what my potential is, and if I have a shot at World Record maybe I'll try a little further as long as I feel like it.
